summary: SM 6.6 silently accepts what SM 6.5 correctly rejects: repro.hlsl compiles clean at -T cs_6_6 but -T cs_6_5 fails with 'local resource not guaranteed to map to unique global resource'. Confirmed on main-debug (89e2f98e2), on both probed SM-6.6-shipping endpoints (v1.6.2104, v1.9.2607, agreeing), and on dxc_trunk via Compiler Explorer. Negative control (unambiguous resource index) compiles clean at both profiles, ruling out a vacuous match. Matches maintainer's 2023-11-01 finding (1); finding (2), full CF flattening of the phi/undef, is a separate unresolved ask not re-measured here.
